name: 马丁·韦尔代

last_movies.title: L’État des lieux sera dressé à onze heures en présence de la femme du poète

introduction: Born in 1970, Martin Verdet graduated in 1992 from the ESAG Graphic Art School. He practices graphics, painting, scenography and installations. From 2001, his cinema strives throughout his films to build and develop a resolutely personal writing, mixing intimacy and surrealism, documentary and fiction. He pays great attention to the relationship between sound and his images which he frames himself.
